_about: End-to-end MAS prediction eval fixtures. One block per registered capability (14). Each query is run through the FULL agent (run_agent) so manager routing + dispatch + handler + model are all exercised. score_mode drives which check the runner applies. Realised-label ACCURACY is NOT scored here (the deployed artefacts are refit on all rows and the agent forecasts the latest season -> next, whose label is unavailable/leaked); leakage-free accuracy lives in the model-level holdout (PREDICTION_ROBUSTNESS.md / eval_tasks.py). This family scores ROUTING correctness + output PLAUSIBILITY for all 14 capabilities. Entities are real 2024-25 PL clubs/players.
